priorNumbersAudit.auditExplanation: In multi_league_team_ratings_v1.0.json (pinnacleBenchmark) and h8_walkforward_backtest_recompute_report.json (pinnacleComparison), the 80 matched ENG-PL fixtures yielded: (1) retired pre-H8 fractional AH scoring (HALF_WIN=0.75, PUSH=0.5, HALF_LOSS=0.25): Model 0.2088 vs Pinnacle Closing 0.2089 (compressed toward 0.21 solely by fractional 0.25/0.5/0.75 outcome coding on quarter/whole lines); (2) H8 binary no-push per-leg AH scoring (121 legs -> 16 pushes excluded -> 105 resolved binary legs): Model 0.2501 vs Pinnacle Closing 0.2516 (paired delta -0.0015, 95% CI [-0.0207, +0.0179]), and on the strict non-quarter single-line subset where legLine === AHCh (39 legs -> 7 pushes excluded -> 32 resolved binary legs): Model 0.2561 vs Pinnacle Closing 0.2535 (paired delta +0.0026, 95% CI [-0.0262, +0.0319]); (3) identical-leg OU 2.5 (80 fixtures = 80 binary legs on line 2.5, Over 2.5): Model 0.2612 vs Pinnacle Closing 0.2436 (paired delta +0.0176, 95% CI [-0.0044, +0.0406]). The figures 0.2202 vs 0.2072 and 0.2581 vs 0.2412 cited in the earlier narrative summary were manual transcription errors in the markdown report; the JSON artifacts and deterministic code always produced the exact figures above.
